title: indexing expressions can ignore fake borrows when an index diverges
author: dianne
body_preview: Currently for chained-together indexing expressions, we emit fake reads for fake borrows only at the very end. title: Cargo does not return tokens immediately after finishing a single job
author: mgorny
body_preview: ### Problem  The current jobserver implementation in Cargo is built to consume as much tokens as possible, and hold on to them for as long as there is work to do.
